item_reviews.comment: Supported (91.4 vs 89.7, p=0.0011, CI 1.14–2.26), but clean accuracy is background, not the JPEG robustness answer.
Drops 0.1–1.8 at all five qualities, all ≤2.0 criterion; directly answers the question.
Ferncastle drops 0.3, 1.2 then 2.6, 4.9, 9.8; meets criterion only at 90 and 70.
S1 covers only clean accuracy; JPEG tables are means with no tests or intervals. Valid scope caveat.

missing_core_findings.description: Loamwise-ViT's JPEG robustness does not generalize to all perturbations: it exceeded the 2.0-point criterion under motion blur at 7 px (2.9) and 11 px (6.1) and under brightness ×0.6 (wait 1.7 meets) and ×0.4 (3.4). Robustness is specific to JPEG, although it still dropped less than Ferncastle-CNN.
